reason: A web-panel plugin that visualizes files and edits made by an agent during a session, with a separate read-only comparison between the workspace and HEAD.

summaries.zh: 在会话面板中集中展示 Agent 修改过的文件与编辑内容，并提供工作区与 HEAD 的只读对照。
summaries.en: Displays an agent’s session file changes and edits in a review panel, with a separate read-only comparison between the workspace and HEAD.

capabilities: Reads session projection data about agent file edits
Displays file-change summaries and diffs in a web panel
Compares the workspace with HEAD using read-only local git operations
